failure_modes: The W2_middle_peak run leaves the landmark_00_soft_mass mid-window plateau unchanged relative to M2 (same sign pattern and comparable node z-values), so the timing hypothesis is not supported.
The primary final predicted affinity metric does not improve over M2, or validity/strain degrade, despite the intended coordinate response.
The observed mid-window mass plateau is a clone-dependent or batch-turnover artifact rather than a stable temporal signal, so the dose redistribution produces no reproducible coordinate change.
Realized-dose auditing shows the per-seed flow scales or safety caps prevent the registered [0.5,1.5,0.5] ratio from being realized, so the edit does not change execution.

The probed curves are untyped coordinate proxies; a coordinate contrast or its time derivative does not establish an absolute target or an optimal guidance dose, so any apparent benefit is not evidence of improved affinity.
rationale: Adopt H002 as the primary basis: the landmark_00_soft_mass curve (Eef4385e476674774) is the most stable probed observable (relative_node_RMSE 0.29) and shows a rise from a negative start to a positive mid-window plateau (t~0.14-0.30) before declining toward zero by t~0.49. A mid-window emphasis in the registered dose lane (W2_middle_peak, dose [0.5,1.5,0.5] over knots [0,0.5,1], same M2 reward geometry, delta and blend unchanged) is the offered choice that matches this observed mid-window mass plateau while preserving the frozen temperatures and eta. H001 (landmark_00_local_dx, E4bbe368c52deda38) and H003 (landmark_10_soft_mass, Ee9d172f45c064a2e) show sign reversals that a single stationary dose cannot match, but their node-level oscillations are not an absolute coordinate target or a spatial gradient, so they are cited as secondary support rather than as the basis for a different recipe. The score clock (E0857891f4effbfe1) confirms the observed window [0.0,0.49] over which the recipe is normalized, with no extrapolation. This is a dose-lane edit only; no reward-lane or curvature change is made.
